title: Rank movement, overtake and streak event v1
description: Typed ranking events, each naming the exact prior and current sealed generations it compares. docs/architecture/SERVER_API_DATA_AND_RANKING_CONTRACT.md is the normative owner. Events are keyed on erasure-domain pseudonyms, so an erasure suppresses an event by the same key destruction that suppresses an entry, rather than by a second deletion path.

counterpart_erasure_domain_id.description: Present exactly on an overtake, which is the only two-party event. An overtake requires strictly greater credited burn than the counterpart, not display-order movement within a tie.

current_generation.description: Strictly greater than prior_generation. Both name sealed generations of the same view, so an event always cites two comparable snapshots rather than a live read.

retracted_at.description: A late claim or a correction can make an emitted event untrue. Retraction is appended rather than applied by deleting the event, and the notification it produced is retracted through the notification-delivery machine.
